meta.og_title: Never Lose a Job to a Missed Call or a Slow Quote
meta.og_description: Built for roofing and waterproofing contractors. One missed call can cost you a job worth tens of thousands — the Job Catcher makes sure it doesn't happen.

offer.name: Job Catcher
offer.one_liner: I make sure you never lose a job to a missed call or a slow quote.
offer.headline: Never lose a job to a missed call.
offer.subhead: Built for roofing and waterproofing contractors who are on a roof, not by the phone.

pain_lines: A missed call at 7pm could be a R40,000 roof replacement going to the next guy on the list.
You're on a roof, not by a phone — every ring you can't answer is a quote you never get to send.
Quotes go out and go quiet. No one chases them, so no one closes them.

modules.title: Missed call text-back
modules.description: Every missed call gets an instant WhatsApp or SMS: "Sorry we missed you, what can we help with?" — so the lead doesn't call the next number on the list.

modules.title: Instant lead reply
modules.description: Website and Facebook enquiries get a reply within a minute, with qualifying questions — roof type, leak or full job, area, photos.

modules.title: Inspection booking
modules.description: Qualified leads pick an inspection slot straight into your calendar — no back-and-forth.

modules.title: Quote follow-up
modules.description: Sent quotes get automatic nudges on day 2, 5 and 10 until the client says yes or no.

modules.title: Review requests
modules.description: Finished jobs get a review request, so your Google profile keeps growing on its own.

proof.case_study_blurb: No live case study yet — King of Paintings never closed (lead went cold, see project_king_of_paintings memory). No proof point exists until the first real client. Do not reference King of Paintings as a client anywhere in marketing.

pricing.founding_offer: Setup at cost, 3-month minimum on monthly — first 3 local clients only.
pricing.justification_line: What's an average job worth to you? If this saves one job a month, it pays for itself several times over.

objections.response: Great — this covers after hours, weekends and her lunch break.
What's one job worth to you? This needs to save one a year to pay off.
You don't touch it. I set it up and run it; you just see the bookings come in.

faqs.q: How fast does the missed-call text go out?
faqs.a: Within seconds of the missed call — before the caller has even put their phone down.

faqs.q: Do I need to change my phone number?
faqs.a: No — it works with the number you already use.

faqs.q: What happens to my current receptionist or admin?
faqs.a: Nothing changes for them. This covers the gaps — after hours, weekends, lunch breaks, and while you're on site.
Most contractors are live within a week of signing.

target: Runs Google or Facebook ads, active Google profile
avoid: Word of mouth only, no online presence
